description: For every fixed PA derivation of the universal closure of \(A(\vec x)\), the specified universal-elimination program produces an accepted certificate for the actual numeral-instance code \(\operatorname{sub}_A(\vec n)\), at every internal input tuple in every PA model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.certified_specializeFixed.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  {r : ℕ} (A : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin r))
  (hA :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.close A))
  (x : Fin r → M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier
    ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.specializeFixed A hA).value x)
    ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.FixedSyntaxPrograms.substitution A).value x)
